title: Change StyleBox content margins type from float to integer.
body:
### Tested versions

current master.

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

`StyleBox` content margins are defined in pixels but are handled as floating-point values internally. In editor, however, margins are treated as integers (from the editor inspector), which creates inconsistency.

This leads to problems for `Control` nodes that draw text or rely on `StyleBox::get_margin(Side)` and `StyleBox::get_minimum_size()` for layout:

Example:
- If you call `StyleBox.set_content_margin_all(1.5)`, the left and right margins are both stored as 1.5.
- When calculating the minimum size, `StyleBox::get_minimum_size()` will return `Vector2(3, 3)` (summing the fractional margins).
- During drawing, however, we have to decide whether to ceil, round, or floor these fractional margins to avoid artifacts.

This creates a mismatch:
- For layout, the minimum size is reported with the fractional values summed.
- For drawing, integer rounding is always necessary, otherwise text and controls won’t align correctly on the pixel grid.

As a result, developers will be forced to work around this by manually recalculating the effective minimum size with integer casts and to avoid using `StyleBox::get_minimum_size()`:

```c++
Size2 ms = Size2(
    (int)style->get_margin(SIDE_LEFT) + (int)style->get_margin(SIDE_RIGHT),
    (int)style->get_margin(SIDE_TOP) + (int)style->get_margin(SIDE_BOTTOM)
);
```

Note: I have changed them internally without breaking compatibility and it still fixes the issue, https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/110791.

### Steps to reproduce

I have only tested it for `TextEdit` and i have seen other issues related to inconsistent node height that are also caused by floating-point margins, and we may find more related issues for the nodes that draws text and uses `StyleBox::get_minimum_size`.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b2b3b46-36fb-43f4-920d-18249ce453b8

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


<details>
<summary>Script used in the video (Click to Expand)</summary>

```gdscript
@tool
class_name CodeEditTest
extends CodeEdit

var update_requested: bool = false

@export_enum("default", "floor", "round", "ceil") var operation = 0:
	set(value):
		operation = value
		request_update()

@export_range(0, 16, 1.0, "prefer_slider") var normal_content_margin: int = 4:
	set(value):
		if normal_content_margin == value:
			return
		normal_content_margin = value
		request_update()

@export_range(0.5, 2, 0.01) var editor_scale: float = 1.0:
	set(value):
		if editor_scale == value:
			return
		editor_scale = value
		request_update()

@export var normal_style: StyleBoxFlat = StyleBoxFlat.new():
	set(value):
		if normal_style == value:
			return
		normal_style = value
		if normal_style:
			add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal_style)
		else:
			remove_theme_stylebox_override("normal")
		text = "(\"Long Long Long Long Long Long Long Long Long Long Long Long Line\")"
		request_update()


func request_update():
	if update_requested:
		return
	update_requested = false
	_update.call_deferred()


func _update():
	if normal_style:
		normal_style.bg_color = Color.BLACK
		normal_style.draw_center = false
		var margin: float = normal_content_margin * editor_scale
		match operation:
			1:
				margin = floor(margin)
			2:
				margin = round(margin)
			3:
				margin = ceil(margin)
			_:
				pass
		normal_style.set_content_margin_all(margin)
		normal_style.set_border_width_all(normal_content_margin * editor_scale)
		prints("left_margin:", normal_style.get_margin(SIDE_LEFT), "right_margin:", normal_style.get_margin(SIDE_RIGHT))
		prints("style minimum size:", normal_style.get_minimum_size())
		prints("Control minimum size:", get_minimum_size())
		print()
	set_deferred("scroll_horizontal", 10000)
	


func _init() -> void:
	line_folding = true
	gutters_draw_breakpoints_gutter = true
	gutters_draw_bookmarks = true
	gutters_draw_executing_lines = true
	gutters_draw_fold_gutter = true
	gutters_draw_line_numbers = true
	minimap_draw = true
	resized.connect(request_update)

```
